reviews.text: We loved taking our dog Archer to Linda - the best grooming and cut with special attention to detail that we haven’t experienced anywhere else in Amsterdam. However - is PetStylist still open? I have been trying to contact Linda and her team for months with no answer?

Linda is such an amazing professional and great person, she has been taking care of our Mylo for quite some time now, even though our dog is complicated and dramatic, she always excels as her job and delivers a fluffy dog with a smile on her face. We recommend Linda 100%!

Edit May 2026: we contacted Linda for Mylo’s grooming as usual, she completely stopped answering us, we don’t know what happened. But it left our dog without a hair appointment for many more weeks while we struggle with finding a new one.
My dog ​​received a very loving and beautiful grooming. He feels safe and is completely happy again! The care is wonderful. Toto is thrilled with this grooming salon, and so is his owner!

Pincho looks amazing after his grooming session! He’s now a super clean, happy dog and we couldn’t be more pleased. The Pet Stylist team did a fantastic job—highly recommended for anyone wanting their pup to look and feel great!
Amazing stylist. My dog always looks nice afterward. Already going there for years. Still very happy. Highly recommended.
After my visit to Pet Stylist, I am completely dissatisfied with the result and the owner is very unfriendly to customers.

Normally, I was satisfied. Until I had my Pomeranian clipped by Linda, the owner, for the first time. Even the hygiene areas seemed untouched! I was allowed to return, but I still wasn't satisfied with the result. I gave it another try, and to my surprise, when I got there, the owner told me, irritated, that she hadn't hired me because she was so busy and, as she says, needed days off. Without any troubleshooting whatsoever, I just left. No more pet stylists for me!
It was Pietje's first time, so he found it exciting. Linda washed and groomed him with lots of patience and love 🧼. He looks beautiful again. Until next time! …

Linda is honestly Amsterdam’s most dedicated pet groomer.  My beloved 3 year old Pomeranian was rejected from two groomers because he had the most terrible matting and not even the most reputable groomers we visited had the expertise to handle his situation, Linda educated us about his situation and warned us about all possible outcomes and risks, my dog fell in love with her and 3 hours later he was finally comfortable and happy. Although it was his first grooming experience , she made sure he was comfortable at all times reserving a time space just for his appointment. The Pomeranian oriented pampering and aftercare advice were highly appreciated. Very reasonable fares also. My little Hermes has now officially a groomer for life. Thank you Linda for accepting him and for your hard work and dedication.
